items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Schwartz and Dietz, all those songs, “I guess I’ll have to change my plan” and all that stuff.

ctx.x: I guess that’s mark of a great lyric. If you take the music away you still have a —
Of course. Schwartz and Dietz, all those songs, “I guess I’ll have to change my plan” and all that stuff. It makes a lot of sense.
By the way you play on one of my new favorite albums, and that is Dick Hyman “The Age of Swing.”
